text: Alla ɓurɗo moƴƴude diina haa hewta on jebbilaniiɗo Alla kene e gunndoo o laɓɓini anuyee makko, o moƴƴini golle makko ɗen, o jokki diina Annabi Ibraahiima kan, iwdi diina Muhammadu (yo o his), ooñiiɗo gaay e sirku e keeferaaku faade e tawhiidi e gomɗinal. Alla Suɓike Ibraahiima Annabiijo Makko (yo o his), O Yiɗiri mo giggol timmungol e nder tagu Makko ngun denndaangal.
